objective.jobToBeDone: Compile and share client-facing billing summaries by reviewing accumulated job costs, creating draft summaries for a billing period, and sharing them with the client before invoice generation.
objective.primaryDecision: Select a billing summary to review its cost breakdown, then either create a new one or share a draft with the client.
objective.usageFrequency: Occasional / back-office — billing staff uses this at billing cycle milestones, not continuously.

criticalActions.presentation: primary-button opening an inline period-date form above the list; projectId is context-derived from route, never typed

contextual-transition-actions — a single 'Share with Client' button rendered on the selected draft row/detail panel; billingSummaryId is derived from selection, never typed; status transition is a button, never a select
master-detail table with filter bar folded into the surface header

informationHierarchy: 1. Billing summaries list filtered by project and status (browse context)
2. Selected summary cost breakdown: labor, material, change-order, total, period, status
3. Create new billing summary (period date inputs, project from context)
4. Share selected draft summary with client (transition action)
objective.successCriteria: Billing staff can scan all summaries for a project, see cost totals at a glance, create a new draft in two date inputs, and share a draft with one click — without typing any ids or manually setting status.
antiPatterns: Separate full-page form for sharing (should be inline contextual transition)
Status field as a free <select> input
Stacking create form and share form as independent sections below the list
Showing system-owned fields (createdAt, updatedAt) as editable inputs
